morpheus.title: Morpheus
morpheus.subtitle: AI execution platform — plan, permission, execute, audit.

launcher.title: Actions
launcher.description: Actions use plan-level trust and exact scopes.
launcher.safeDescription: Real capabilities available on this machine.

appLaunch.label: Launch an approved application
appLaunch.description: Starts an application from the built-in approved list.

fileCreateText.label: Create a text file
fileCreateText.description: Writes a new text file inside the approved Morpheus folder.

systemReport.label: Report system information
systemReport.description: Collects privacy-safe details about this machine's runtime.

fileReadText.label: Read a file
fileReadText.description: Reads a text file from the approved workspace.

fileList.label: List folder contents
fileList.description: Lists the files and folders in the approved workspace.

fileSearch.label: Find files by name
fileSearch.description: Searches file and folder names in the approved workspace.

fileAppendText.label: Append to a file
fileAppendText.description: Adds text to the end of an existing file. Nothing is overwritten.

fileMove.label: Move or rename
fileMove.description: Moves a file within the workspace. Refuses to overwrite anything.

fileCopy.label: Copy a file
fileCopy.description: Copies a file within the workspace. Refuses to overwrite anything.

folderCreate.label: Create a folder
folderCreate.description: Creates a folder in the approved workspace.

fileDelete.label: Delete permanently
fileDelete.description: Permanently removes a file or folder. This cannot be undone.

clipboardReadText.label: Read the clipboard
clipboardReadText.description: Reads whatever is currently on the clipboard. Asks before the first use.

clipboardWriteText.label: Copy to the clipboard
clipboardWriteText.description: Replaces the clipboard contents with text you provide.

systemNotify.label: Show a notification
systemNotify.description: Shows a desktop notification. Reads nothing and leaves nothing behind.

screenCapture.label: Take a screenshot
screenCapture.description: Captures the screen and saves it in the approved workspace. Every capture is shown and recorded.

systemStorage.label: Inspect storage
systemStorage.description: Reports aggregate storage capacity for the approved Morpheus files location.

systemProcesses.label: Inspect running processes
systemProcesses.description: Lists running Windows processes. Asks before the first use.

webOpenUrl.label: Open an approved web URL
webOpenUrl.description: Opens an explicit http or https URL in the system browser.

devLaunchProject.label: Open a project in VS Code
devLaunchProject.description: Opens an existing folder inside the approved workspace in the installed VS Code.

permission.title: Confirm this action
permission.noTarget: This action reads runtime information only. Nothing is written or launched.
permission.scopeNote: Saved decisions apply only to this exact action and target.
permission.degradedExplanation: Auditing is unavailable, so Morpheus is running in a reduced-capability state. Only privacy-safe read-only actions can run until auditing recovers.

strict.name: Strict
strict.description: Read-only checks run automatically. Everything that writes or launches asks every time.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: Read-only checks run automatically. Other actions ask the first time, and you can remember that decision for an exact target.

autonomous.name: Autonomous
autonomous.description: Routine work runs inside trusted scopes without interruption. Morpheus asks only when trust materially expands; critical actions still require confirmation.

reasons.profile-auto: Ran automatically: allowed by the current profile
reasons.session-grant: Ran automatically: allowed for this session
reasons.persistent-grant: Ran automatically: saved approval for this exact target
reasons.mandatory-confirmation: Confirmation always required for this risk level

plan.title: Approve this plan
plan.description: Morpheus needs your permission before running “{{objective}}”.
plan.mandatoryNote: This cannot be remembered and will be asked again next time.
plan.note: Everything else in this plan is already covered by your existing permissions.

permission.planFirst: Trust is evaluated once for the complete plan, then approved steps run sequentially.

groups.workspace.write: Create and change files in this workspace

timeline.title: Execution timeline
timeline.description: Live phases reported by the main process.
timeline.emptyDescription: Run an action to see its real execution phases here.

readiness.sequential: Plans execute sequentially. Morpheus evaluates trust once before the first real step.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Append-only record. File content is never stored.
audit.emptyDescription: Every confirmed or denied action is recorded here.

command.label: Command
command.placeholder: Tell Morpheus what you want to accomplish…
command.question: What should Morpheus handle?
command.promise: Morpheus builds a typed plan, asks only when trust changes, then executes it step by step.
command.unsupportedBody: That command does not map to a capability Morpheus actually has. It supports:

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.empty: No artifacts yet. Completed actions appear here.

plan.title: Execution plan
plan.description: What Morpheus will do, in order.
plan.empty: No plan yet. Describe what you want in the command bar.
plan.readyBody: Describe the outcome. Morpheus will construct a typed plan, compare its complete trust boundary, and execute observable steps.
plan.liveBody: Morpheus is interpreting the complete objective and constructing a bounded plan.
plan.noExecutablePlan: No executable plan was produced for this objective.

workspaces.title: Trusted workspaces
workspaces.description: Choose where Morpheus may work. Paths come only from the Windows folder picker; trust stays bound to one exact canonical root.
workspaces.authorityNote: Selecting a workspace does not grant authority. Morpheus evaluates the complete plan against its exact root and reuses only matching trust. Downgrading or disabling a workspace revokes remembered grants for that root.

agentProfiles.title: Agent Profiles
agentProfiles.description: Reusable planning identities that constrain provider, context, workspace, capabilities and risk. They never bypass Main-owned policy.
agentProfiles.authorityNote: This profile narrows plan construction. Every real target is still resolved, permissioned and audited by Morpheus Main.
agentProfiles.removeDescription: This removes the custom profile definition only. Morpheus blocks removal while a workflow still uses it.
agentProfiles.resetDescription: Built-in profiles return to their shipped configuration. Custom profiles remain untouched.

editor.description: Configure how Morpheus plans and which boundaries this profile may propose. Main policy remains authoritative.
editor.name: Name
editor.boundaryDescription: This allowlist can narrow execution only. It never creates a permission grant.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Reusable multi-step systems that compile into the same sequential typed plans as Command Center objectives.
workflows.removeDescription: This removes the custom workflow definition. Schedules that still reference it must be removed first.

editor.description: Build a bounded, reusable sequence. Every run enters the same Objective Core and plan-level trust evaluation.
editor.name: Workflow name
editor.triggersDescription: A trigger may start this workflow; it never bypasses trust or policy.
editor.sequentialNote: Windows 1.0 executes ready steps sequentially. Dependencies still define ordering and skip behavior.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: Morpheus-owned automation. Every scheduled workflow still passes through exact-scope trust, policy and audit.
schedules.createDescription: Choose a real workflow and a bounded trigger.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.removeDescription: The schedule definition will be removed. Existing objective and audit history remains append-only.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Append-only execution, permission and automation history across retained audit days.
activity.ledgerDescription: Newest first. Payloads and secrets are never retained.
activity.empty: No matching activity has been recorded.

runtimeControl.description: Pause prevents new objectives and schedules from starting. Active work may finish safely, and normal Chat remains available.

quickCommand.title: Quick Command
quickCommand.unsupported: That objective is not supported yet.
quickCommand.hint: Enter runs the objective. Morpheus asks only when trust changes.

missions.select: Select a Mission to inspect its real state.
missions.noSummary: This Mission has not produced a final result yet.
missions.noArtifacts: This Mission has not produced artifacts.

activation.title: Meet Morpheus
activation.introduction: I turn objectives into plans, trusted actions and lasting Missions. Speak or type naturally; I will handle routine work and interrupt only when the trust boundary genuinely changes.
activation.spokenIntroduction: Hello. I am Morpheus, your intelligent operating companion. Tell me what you want to accomplish, and I will plan and handle the work.
activation.checking: Inspecting the capabilities available on this system…
activation.preferenceTitle: How should Morpheus work with you?
activation.preferenceBody: These preferences shape communication. They never bypass capability policy or trust.
activation.speakDescription: Use Windows speech after completed voice objectives.
activation.readyBody: Use the Command Center for Missions, press Ctrl+Shift+Space from anywhere for Quick Command, or press Ctrl+Alt+Space to speak.
activation.replayDescription: Replay the real system introduction and choose companion behavior again.

adaptive.name: Adaptive
adaptive.description: Match detail, tone and pace to the objective.

concise.name: Concise
concise.description: Prefer brief, direct status and results.

warm.name: Warm
warm.description: Use a conversational, helpful and lightly humorous voice.

signal.optionalProvider: Configure when you need open-ended planning

today.title: Today
today.clear: Nothing needs your attention. Morpheus is watching the real work, not inventing urgency.

itemTitles.routine-candidate: This repeated work could become a System

settings.title: Proactive intelligence
settings.description: Morpheus watches durable Goals, Missions, schedules, routines, and reminders for factual next actions.
settings.enabledDescription: Surface real attention from durable Morpheus state without inventing tasks or urgency.
settings.notificationsDescription: Deliver at most one relevant notification per scan outside quiet hours.
settings.factualDisclosure: Notifications are generated only from inspectable Morpheus state. Provider output cannot silently create them.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Give Missions a durable purpose, measurable milestones, and a truthful next action.
goals.empty: No Goals yet. Create one for work that should continue across multiple Missions.
goals.select: Select a Goal or create a new one.
goals.name: Goal name
goals.noMilestones: No milestones yet. Progress remains 0% until real milestones are completed.
goals.removeMessage: The Goal record will be removed. Existing Missions and artifacts remain intact.

systems.title: Systems
systems.description: Design, prove, and activate reliable AI systems from real Morpheus workflows.
systems.empty: No Systems yet. Turn a reviewed workflow or eligible Mission into reusable work.
systems.select: Select a System or create a new one.
systems.trustDisclosure: Activation creates no permission grant. Every run still enters Objective Core and is evaluated against exact current trust.
systems.detailsHint: Select a saved System to inspect its exact boundary and test evidence.
systems.name: System name
systems.editorDescription: References are logical. Main derives the Agent Profile and exact capabilities from the selected workflow.
systems.noMatchingSchedules: No schedule matches this workflow and workspace. The System can still run manually.
systems.removeMessage: The System record will be removed. Existing Missions, workflows, schedules, and artifacts remain intact.
systems.conversionFailed: This Mission cannot become a reusable System.

settings.title: Voice operator
settings.ready: Ready through {{provider}}. Audio and transcripts are never written to audit history.
settings.unavailable: No compatible transcription provider is configured.
settings.enabledDescription: Allow the microphone controls and global voice shortcut to capture an objective.
settings.ambientDescription: Keep Morpheus available in the background and respond only after the exact wake phrase.
settings.ambientDisclosure: Ambient mode detects speech locally, then sends bounded utterances to {{provider}} for transcription. Audio and transcripts are never saved. This release does not claim an offline wake-word engine.
settings.bargeInDescription: Speaking stops immediately when you begin talking.
settings.autoSubmitDescription: Send a successful transcript into the same Objective Core without another click.
settings.speakResponsesDescription: Read concise completion or clarification messages through Windows speech synthesis.
